title: Check RMS for Overall System AGV Status to confirm remote availability
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status web UI to open the page titled “Overall System AGV Status” and confirm the page loads and displays the current overall system status content. This is used to verify remote availability of the RMS overview page.
when_to_use: When you need to confirm that the RMS fleet status UI is reachable remotely and that the “Overall System AGV Status” overview page is displaying the current overall system status.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a deep-dive for a single AGV’s active error/fault details; this procedure only confirms the overall status page is reachable and populated.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open RMS / fleet status UI remotely, navigate to “Overall System AGV Status”, and verify the page loads and shows current overall system status content.

access_required: Remote access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the “Overall System AGV Status” page title and the statement that this page will show the current status (used as visual reference for what to look for on the page).

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (RMS web UI)
steps.purpose: Establish that the RMS fleet status UI is reachable remotely before checking the specific overview page.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status web UI (rms_ui).
steps.expected_result: RMS / fleet status UI opens successfully (i.e., you can proceed to navigate within RMS).
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS UI is reachable and responsive enough to navigate to the “Overall System AGV Status” page.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS UI cannot be reached or is not responsive (remote availability cannot be confirmed).

actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (RMS web UI).
